transcript.text: I need to formally share my privacy findings with the group. Yesterday I held a working session with our product lead and privacy office, and we confirmed that the company's non-negotiable clinical-data position is: (1) publication containing patient-level data is prohibited, and (2) de-identification is required before any permitted external publication. The working-session minutes have not yet been circulated to the deal team, so I'm putting this on the record now. This directly conflicts with the current draft's broad publication permission for project results, which does not include these patient-data protections.

decisions.background_ip_treatment: Background patents U1, U2, and U3 must be excluded from the commercial license grant, as they are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use under the university's controlling master research agreement schedule. The commercial license grant must be narrowed to cover only background technology that is actually available for commercial use.
decisions.publication_of_patient_level_data: Prohibited — publication containing patient-level data is not permitted under any circumstances.

commitments.detail: Revise the draft agreement to exclude background patents U1, U2, and U3 from the commercial license grant and add a requirement for separate written university consent before any commercial use of those patents.
Revise the publication provisions to prohibit publication containing patient-level data and require de-identification before any permitted external publication of project results.
Incorporate the IP finding into the draft and circulate the updated background IP schedule to the deal team.
Circulate the working-session minutes from the privacy office consultation to the deal team for the record.
Final Legal Director approval will be granted once the revised draft reflecting both the IP exclusions and the clinical-data publication protections has been reviewed and confirmed.
